_doc: Materials for PTCryspMC. density [g/cm^3]; components = element mass fractions (informational); xcom = NIST XCOM mass-attenuation table [cm^2/g], path relative to data/. Transport uses incoherent + photoelectric + pair channels: Sigma = (mu/rho) * density. Scintillators also carry, keyed to the crystal name: light_yield_per_MeV [photons/MeV], scint_decay_ns + scint_decay_w (decay-component lifetimes [ns] and weights summing to 1), eres_a (fractional energy-resolution FWHM at 511 keV).

Air._note: no xcom: treated as non-interacting (straight-line propagation)
